description: This shell script automates testing of Git repository selection logic, particularly in cases involving ambiguous or complex repository directory structures. It defines functions for setting up Git repositories (both bare and working tree), fetching, and checking repository status, then runs a series of tests to ensure correct behavior in various scenarios.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Removes specific directories to reset the testing environment.

methods.name: make_tree
methods.description: Initializes a new Git repository as a working tree and makes an initial commit.

methods.name: make_bare
methods.description: Initializes a bare Git repository and creates an initial commit.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches from a given repository and clones it locally.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Compares the actual Git log messages with expected values to verify correct repository fetch behavior.
